dogecoin.text:
Obviously Bitcoin makes new ATHs every cycle. 

Also $doge predates $eth for those unaware

I believe Litecoin is another that meets this specific metric

So I just started accumulating Dogecoin. I’ve faded it since 2020 and always thought it was “meh”

It’s been one of the very few legacy coins, if not only to make a brand new ATH every cycle. 

This alone made me realize there is something more to this alt than most people think
